name: Sequential Batch (Tank B-21)
requirement: Tank B-21 executes Fill/Mix/Drain sequence. Start_PB begins Fill only if Emergency_Stop healthy, Abort_PB inactive, system idle, no fault. Fill until High_Level, then Mix until Mix_Timer_Done, then Drain until Low_Level. Any E_Stop or Abort_PB immediately stops all outputs and latches fault. Reset_PB clears fault when conditions are safe.
safety_constraints: Emergency_Stop or Abort_PB must de-energize Fill_Valve, Mixer_Motor, and Drain_Valve immediately.
Fault must latch after trip and require Reset_PB while safety is healthy.
Invalid or unknown step state must return to idle safe state.

expected_properties.description: State machine progresses Fill -> Mix -> Drain deterministically.
Abort or emergency stop forces all outputs off and latches fault.
